name: Paypal USD Main
oneLiner: senPYUSDmain is Sentora's PYUSD Morpho Vault V2 share; yield and losses change NAV, and cash redemption depends on idle PYUSD.
collateral: PYUSD lending positions against cbBTC, WBTC, LBTC, syrupUSDC, wstETH, weETH, sUSDe, kBTC. Allocations change under curator controls; borrower collateral is distinct from the underlying deposited token.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposit/mint and withdraw/redeem exchange shares for PYUSD at the current asset conversion rate. Lending interest, fees and realized losses change NAV. liquidityAdapter() is zero at the pinned review; ordinary cash redemptions use idle assets unless assets are first deallocated. Shared market liquidity and an in-kind position exit do not promise full-size cash redemption.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum deployment 0xb576765fb15505433af24fee2c0325895c559fb2 is immutable VaultV2, issuing transferable ERC-4626 operational shares over PYUSD, not a direct fiat or parent-reserve ownership claim. asset(), decimals(), totalSupply(), convertToAssets() and ordinary one-share redeem simulation were reverified at Ethereum block 26107702. The protocol-position archetype intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent.
